faqs.q: Is 1xBet licensed in Africa?
faqs.a: 1xBet holds an NLRC licence in Nigeria. In other African markets, it operates under a Curacao eGaming licence. Always verify local regulations before betting. In Nigeria, 1xBet is a fully licensed and regulated operator.

faqs.q: What is the 1xBet bonus in Nigeria?
faqs.a: 1xBet Nigeria offers a 300% first deposit bonus up to ₦1,200,000 with code 1BONUSNG. You must wager the bonus amount x5 on accumulators at minimum odds 1.40 within 30 days to withdraw.

faqs.q: Can I use M-Pesa to deposit on 1xBet in Kenya?
faqs.a: Yes. 1xBet Kenya accepts M-Pesa deposits. Go to Deposit → M-Pesa → enter your Safaricom number and amount → confirm with PIN. Minimum deposit is KSh 50. Withdrawals to M-Pesa process in 5–30 minutes.

faqs.q: Which African countries does 1xBet cover?
faqs.a: 1xBet is available in all 21 African countries covered by SifuFinds: Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, Ethiopia, Ivory Coast, Cameroon, Senegal, Rwanda, Zimbabwe, Malawi, Mozambique, Angola, DR Congo, Botswana, Namibia, Egypt, and Morocco.

review_page_copy.tagline: 100% Welcome Bonus — Live in 7 African Markets
review_page_copy.bonus: 100% First Deposit Bonus — Up to ₦207,500 (Nigeria) / KSh 19,000 (Kenya) / GH₵1,491 (Ghana)
review_page_copy.bonus_desc: 100% match on your first deposit, capped per country. Wager the bonus amount 5x on accumulators at minimum odds 1.40 within 30 days.
review_page_copy.acca_boost: Same 100% offer live in Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia and Ivory Coast

review_page_copy.verdict: 22Bet is a Cyprus-based international operator running fully licensed local operations across seven of the African markets SifuFinds covers — Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia and Ivory Coast — rather than relying on a single offshore licence for the whole continent. The flat 100% first deposit bonus is easy to understand and repeats identically in every market, with 35+ sports and cash-out available throughout. It lacks the live streaming some rivals offer, but the straightforward 5x wagering requirement and consistently fast payout reputation make it a solid all-round pick, particularly for bettors who move between more than one of its live markets.
pros: Locally licensed in all 7 markets it operates in, not just a single offshore licence
35+ sports including niche markets alongside football
Same easy-to-understand 100% welcome bonus in every country
Straightforward 5x wagering at minimum odds 1.40
Cash-out available on all markets
Reputation for fast, reliable payouts
cons: No live streaming on any market
Welcome bonus capped lower than some rivals (e.g. 1xBet's 200–300% offers)
Fewer local payment rails than Kenya/Nigeria-first brands like Bet9ja

faqs.q: Is 22Bet licensed in Africa?
faqs.a: 22Bet holds a local licence in each African market it operates in through SifuFinds: NLRC in Nigeria, BCLB in Kenya, GCA in Ghana, GBT in Tanzania, UNCS in Uganda, GLB in Zambia, and ARJEL in Ivory Coast.

faqs.q: What is the 22Bet welcome bonus?
faqs.a: 22Bet offers a 100% first deposit bonus, capped per country — up to ₦207,500 in Nigeria, KSh 19,000 in Kenya, and GH₵1,491 in Ghana. Use code BNSNG. The bonus must be wagered 5x on accumulators at minimum odds 1.40 within 30 days.

faqs.q: Which African countries does 22Bet cover?
faqs.a: 22Bet is available in seven African countries covered by SifuFinds: Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, and Ivory Coast.

faqs.q: Does 22Bet offer live streaming?
faqs.a: No. Unlike some rivals, 22Bet does not currently offer live match streaming in its African markets. It does support cash-out on all listed markets.

faqs.q: Is Hollywoodbets licensed in South Africa?
faqs.a: Yes. Hollywoodbets holds licences from multiple Provincial Gambling Boards including the WCGRB, NGB, and ECGBB. FICA (Financial Intelligence Centre Act) compliance is required for all South African customers, in line with national gambling regulations.

faqs.q: How do I claim the Hollywoodbets R25 free bet?
faqs.a: Register an account at Hollywoodbets and complete your profile. The R25 free bet is credited automatically upon registration — no deposit required. FICA verification may be needed before withdrawing any winnings.

faqs.q: What payment methods does Hollywoodbets accept?
faqs.a: Hollywoodbets accepts FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, Capitec, Visa, Mastercard, Instant EFT, Blue Voucher, and 1Voucher. Deposits are instant. Withdrawals to bank accounts take 1–3 business days after FICA verification.

faqs.q: Does Hollywoodbets operate outside South Africa?
faqs.a: Yes. Hollywoodbets has expanded to Mozambique, Namibia, Botswana, and beyond. It is the most widely distributed retail bookmaker in Southern Africa.

faqs.q: Is Pepeta licensed in Kenya?
faqs.a: Yes. Pepeta is operated by Norm Kick Off Kenya Limited and holds BCLB licence numbers BK 0000694 and PG 0000421, issued under Kenya's Betting, Lotteries and Gaming Board Act (CAP 131).

faqs.q: What is the Pepeta welcome bonus?
faqs.a: Pepeta offers a 100% match bonus on your first deposit, credited automatically with no promo code needed. Minimum deposit is KSh 100 via M-Pesa or Airtel Money.

faqs.q: Is Pepeta mainly a sportsbook or a casino?
faqs.a: Pepeta positions itself primarily around crash games (including an Aviator-style title) and casino products, with sports betting across 20+ sports as a secondary offering.

faqs.q: When was Pepeta launched?
faqs.a: Pepeta launched in 2023 and is operated by Norm Kick Off Kenya Limited, headquartered in Westlands, Nairobi.

faqs.q: Is SportPesa licensed in Kenya?
faqs.a: Yes. SportPesa holds BCLB licence number BK0000100. It was the first major licensed online bookmaker in Kenya and remains the most popular, with millions of registered Kenyan bettors.

faqs.q: How do I deposit on SportPesa via M-Pesa?
faqs.a: Go to Deposit on SportPesa → Select M-Pesa → Enter your Safaricom number and amount → Confirm with your M-Pesa PIN. Alternatively, use USSD *644# to deposit without internet. Minimum deposit is KSh 10.

faqs.q: What is the SportPesa Mega Jackpot?
faqs.a: The SportPesa Mega Jackpot requires you to correctly predict the outcome of 17 selected football matches. Jackpot prizes can reach KSh 100 million+. Entry costs KSh 99 per betslip with bonus bonuses available.

faqs.q: How fast is SportPesa withdrawal to M-Pesa?
faqs.a: SportPesa M-Pesa withdrawals process in 5–15 minutes. Minimum withdrawal is KSh 100. No withdrawal fees charged by SportPesa.
